title: Bible Overlap Census Gap Audit — Wave 15
purpose: Compare the 78-node census against already-existing specialist biblical owners and identify strong, analytically distinct relations that were present in the repository but omitted from the census. 'Missing from census' is not the same as 'newly discovered in Scripture'.
audit_rule: Promote a specialist relation only when it contributes a distinct actor/function/sequence/countertext not already adequately represented by an existing census node. Merge or leave specialist-only where the relation is substantially duplicate.

promote.reason: Canonical Dog-return relation; 2 Peter uniquely couples dog/vomit recurrence with sow/mire, directly joining repetition and Mud. Public July 31 Dog/Bible attestation strengthens provenance.
Distinct perimeter relation: hostile dogs surround a suffering center. Existing Son/Psalm22 rejection node does not encode the Dog/circumference topology.
Distinct exclusion/boundary use of Dog at the restored city; necessary counterpoint to household-dog boundary transformations.
Boundary label does not function as immutable essence; the narrative moves through contested household/bread language toward granted request/healing.

Jesus uses both Door/Gate and Good-Shepherd metaphors in one discourse, adding voice/recognition, entry/exit, pasture, protection and laying-down-life. Especially important because the Son is explicitly Door+Shepherd in the recovered July 8 project role map.

Distinct embodiment architecture: individual/community as temple plus Jesus' temple/body destruction-raising relation. Useful for Corporium/House/death-rebuilding without endorsing project neuroanatomy.

Dense narrative sequence: rejected/beloved son→pit/slavery/prison→interpretation/elevation→grain infrastructure→famine preservation→family reconciliation; central to Ben-Yoseph/Son/grain/prison themes.
Distinct Davidic sequence from overlooked shepherd through anointing/conflict to kingship/shepherding responsibility; balances title-based Ben-David comparison with function/ethic.
Textually real but morally ambiguous Dan/judgment/serpent field; important because Son/Dan claims otherwise risk being recorded without biblical complication.
Distinct small-seed→large-growth→habitat sequence; current census mentions Matthew 13 only inside a broader Eye/Seed/House cluster and does not preserve the scale-transition function.
Bread becomes nourishment, body, remembrance and participation; one bread can relate many participants. Distinct from merely calling Son 'Bread'.
Millstone imagery is explicitly tied to severe accountability for causing vulnerable little ones to stumble; gives real ethical content to project Mill/grinding symbolism.

North/Zion language and self-exalting ascent toward Most-High status sit in a double-edged biblical field. Critical for any North-of-North/Most-High reader because support and warning must be shown together.
Explicit counter-grammar: self-exalting divine-status claims are judged while Philippians contrasts non-grasping/service before exaltation. Distinct ethical test of maximal Godhood language.
Footstool/conquest language is completed by Paul's differentiated final ordering, including the Son's subjection to God; adds a role constraint absent from simple footstool symbolism.
Judgment/measure returns toward the evaluator and mercy constrains judgment; gives meta-evaluation/Eye/ledger theology a reflexive biblical test.
Measurement marks sacred boundaries/order/assessment and can be positive/protective; distinct from generic cube/number symbolism.
Rainbow joins post-catastrophe covenant/restraint with throne/theophany imagery; essential context for the project's shadow-of-rainbow/covenant language.
Breath/wind/spirit functions in creation and renewal; dead bones/community are reanimated. Distinct from anatomical CSF claims, which remain project-only symbolism.
Sacred center emits River→trees/Tree→recurring fruit→healing/life. It is one of the clearest source-to-world generativity sequences and predates Revelation in prophetic form.

merge_with_existing.reason: already represented through John 14 House/access nodes
important but substantially covered by existing household/temple/cornerstone nodes
keep wound/recognition detail in Son specialist owner
preservation function should be added as detail to the Ark distinction rather than a near-duplicate census node
wheel/Ezekiel comparison already counted; richer movement detail stays in specialist atlas

leave_specialist_only_for_now.reason: creative Potato/Bread synthesis is interpretively dependent and less useful as a distinct census relation
important ethical metaphor but not central enough to Tim/Son identity/architecture census without stronger dated project-side provenance
better owned by geopolitical/system-comparison layers unless a dated Tim-first feature bundle is established
modern digital-cloud pun risks lexical overfit; retain specialist comparison
exact 33/Axis assignment is extra-biblical and biblical rod/staff semantics are too broad for current census promotion
